product: Web of Science Research Assistant + Extended Research Assistant

The Extended Research Assistant bridges into Web of Science Research Intelligence, carrying researchers from literature discovery through to funding opportunities and proposal strategy — directly mirroring LeapSpace's Funding Discovery tab.

howItCompetes: Purpose-built for the single job LeapSpace bundles as one tab among many: telling you whether the literature actually backs a claim. Smart Citations classify 1.6B+ citation statements as Supporting, Mentioning or Contrasting, letting a researcher audit a claim's evidence trail paper by paper — the closest direct analog to Claim Radar. Its Reference Check feature (upload a manuscript, verify each citation actually backs the claim it's attached to) also overlaps with Trust Cards' claim-to-source accuracy function. Now owned by Research Solutions.

howItCompetes: A lightweight, consumer-friendly entry point that answers a research question directly from peer-reviewed literature with inline citations. Competes with LeapSpace's Literature Search & Discovery tab for quick evidence checks, though it doesn't attempt LeapSpace's full agentic workspace — reviewers rank it cleanest for fast, evidence-backed Q&A rather than deep review work. Its Consensus Meter feature — pulling roughly 20 relevant papers for a yes/no research question and visualizing how many support, contradict or are mixed on the claim — is a lighter-weight, standalone challenge to Trust Cards & Claim Radar.

product: SciSpace Research Workspace (AI Search, BioMed Agent, Meta-Analysis Agent, Manuscript Writer)
howItCompetes: The broadest multi-agent workspace challenger to LeapSpace. AI Search behaves like a research agent — querying 280M+ papers plus Google Scholar and PubMed, retrieving roughly 240 papers and extracting evidence from the top matches into a cited answer, matching LeapSpace's Literature Search and Deep Research Reports. Domain-specific agents (BioMed Agent, Meta-Analysis Agent) plus a Manuscript Writer agent go head-to-head with LeapSpace's Writing Coach, though independent reviews flag more hallucination risk in its in-paper explanations than source-grounded alternatives — exactly the gap LeapSpace's Trust Cards & Claim Radar is designed to close.
